cover.headline: The AO's partner machine.
cover.deal: Why the AO keeps signing new brands

rows.sub: Official tequila, ride share, AI marketing
$1m 1 Point Slam, now backed by Haier

caption:
Three deals in eight days. The Australian Open's sponsor machine is running hot.

This month Tennis Australia signed DoorDash for delivery, named Adobe its official AI marketing and creativity partner (Adobe's first tennis deal anywhere) and extended Sky's NZ rights through 2032. The trick is selling tight categories and building more event to sell: AO 2026 drew a record 1,368,043, with Opening Week nearly doubling to 217,999. Formats like the $1m 1 Point Slam give sponsors something new to back, and Nine's 2025-29 rights deal carries a $425m cash component.
